summary: Uses one versioned review-autofix engine with reviewed automatic update PRs.

api.assessment: Removes copied autofix controllers, prompts and tests in favor of an immutable private shared-engine pin. Repository policy, runner and validation choices, release-impact validation, promotion eligibility, bot-comment state, three-attempt budgets, opt-outs and fresh publication checks are preserved. The engine includes bounded recovery for missing regression tests; it does not publish untested fixes. Generated weekly update workflows open reviewable version PRs. Engine access uses a cleared checkout credential before PR dependencies or code execute; publication still runs on a separate fresh runner. No application or SDK requests, authentication, runtime permissions, links, scopes, pagination, exports, downloads, storage policy, flags, processing outputs or infrastructure resources change.

rollout: The pinned engine activates for subsequent runs after this migration merges into the default branch. Existing terminal attempts and human pauses are not reset. Future automatic update PRs require a tested central release promoted to stable and normal consumer review. No application deployment, infrastructure apply or SDK package publication is performed by this change.
data_effect: Existing and newly processed results are unchanged. No customer data migration or processing rerun is required. Web, mobile web, embeds and native iOS behavior are unchanged; no TestFlight or App Store release is involved.
dependencies: Read access to the private KanopyAI/kanopy-autofix engine for the repository automation credential.

developer_notice.reason: Internal review automation consolidation with no customer-facing behavior change.
